items.title: About Co-Desk: Built By Founders for Coworking & Coliving Operators
items.snippet:
> Co-Desk (sometimes written as Codesk or CoDesk) is all-in-one SaaS software for managing coworking spaces and coliving houses. It handles bookings, billing (via Stripe Connect), access control, member and resident management, and community tools, all in a single platform. Founded in 2024, Co-Desk is built by operators for operators, with setup in under 30 minutes. Pricing is pay-as-you-go: EUR 0/month with 2.5% per Stripe transaction, or a Custom plan for non-Stripe setups. Website: https://co-desk.eu
[...]
- Homepage: All-in-one coworking and coliving management platform overview
- About Co-Desk: Company story, mission, and values, built by founders for founders
- Pricing: EUR 0/month with 2.5% per Stripe transaction, or Custom for non-Stripe setups
- Contact: Get a demo or reach the sales team
[...]
- All Features: Complete platform capabilities overview
- Space Management: Desk, room, and bedroom booking with real-time availability, calendars, and QR codes
- AI Analytics: Natural-language queries for occupancy, revenue, and performance insights
- Community Tools: Events, forums, member directory, and cross-location networking
- Integrations: Stripe Connect payments, Kisi and Brivo access control, open API, and webhooks

items.title: Release Notes | Co-Desk Help Center
items.snippet:
Release Notes | Co-Desk Help Center
[...]
- Public API registration endpoint — A new API endpoint allows members to register via external systems and integrations.
[...]
- Setup stage — New operators are walked through a guided setup stage after registration before accessing the full admin panel.
[...]
- Help Desk — Members can submit support tickets through the member portal. Operators manage them from Operations → Help Desk — assign to team members, change status (Open, In Progress, Resolved, Closed), and add internal notes.
[...]
- Developer API — A public API is now available for external integrations. Operators can access API documentation and credentials from their account. Supports bookings, members, and resource queries.
[...]
For questions about a specific release or to report an issue, contact sales@co-desk.eu.

items.title: Getting Started as an Operator | Co-Desk Help Center
items.snippet:
Getting Started as an Operator | Co-Desk Help Center
[...]
Co-Desk is a space management platform built for coworking spaces, coliving properties, event venues, and short-term rental operators. It replaces the spreadsheets, disconnected tools, and manual processes most operators start with — and puts everything in one admin panel.
[...]
Help Desk — Members can submit support requests through the portal. Your team manages and responds to tickets from the admin panel.
[...]
two layers:
[...]
- Operations layer — everything you run day-to-day: bookings, billing, subscriptions, reporting, and member management for your location(s). This is what you interact with in the admin panel.
- Network layer — the infrastructure underneath: central member identity, cross-location access credentials, and platform-level payments. Members get one account that works across every Co-Desk location — yours and any others in the network. You don't configure this directly; it's built in.
[...]
Go to your workspace URL and add`/admin` at the end (e.g.,`yourspace.co-desk.app/admin`). Log in with the credentials you created during sign-up, or with those provided by your Co-Desk account manager.
[...]
How do I contact Co-Desk support? Email sales@co-desk.eu— responses typically within 24 hours. You can also use the contact form at co-desk.us/contact.

items.title: Managing Support Tickets | Co-Desk Help Center
items.snippet:
Managing Support Tickets | Co-Desk Help Center
[...]
The Help Desk is where members can submit questions or requests, and your team can track and respond to them. All tickets are in one place, linked to the right member and space.
[...]
Go to Operations → Help Desk in the left menu. This opens the Tickets list, where you'll see all open, in-progress, and resolved tickets.
[...]
- Save
- Change status — move it through Open → In Progress → Resolved → Closed
- Reassign — hand the ticket to a different staff member
- Add internal notes — visible to your team only, not the member
- Add comments — to communicate through the ticket thread
[...]
Can members submit tickets themselves? Yes — members can submit requests through their member portal. These appear directly in your Tickets list.
[...]

[...]
and go to the Tickets tab.

items.title: Configuring Your Workspace Settings | Co-Desk Help Center
items.snippet:
Configuring Your Workspace Settings | Co-Desk Help Center
[...]
## Inviting Your Team
[...]
Go to Settings → Users to invite staff members (managers, front desk, etc.).
[...]
1. Click Invite user
2. Enter their name and email
3. Assign a role
4. Save — they'll receive an invitation by email
[...]
## Roles and Permissions
[...]
Go to Settings → Roles to review what each role can do. Default roles (Admin, Manager, etc.) can be adjusted, or you can create custom roles.
